snippet.title: Rasmus Klump (PSP) Minis Gameplay
snippet.description:
This video features 3 PSP minis that were only released in Denmark.  

I have no idea who the character is and the game is only in Danish.  
All 3 games feature the same repetitive music. 

The 3 games featured 
Rasmus Klump i Pingonesien 
Rasmus Klump Redder Kyllingerne
Rasmus Klump og den Store Labyrint
